qs.q: Metabolic syndrome diagnosis requires at least 3 of 5 criteria. These are
o: Fever, leukocytosis, raised CRP, elevated ESR, lymphocytosis
Central obesity, hypertension, elevated triglycerides, low HDL, elevated fasting glucose
Peripheral edema, proteinuria, elevated LDL, hyperkalemia, high renin
Hypoglycaemia, bradycardia, low LDL, underweight, low blood pressure
qs.e: Greatly increases CV risk and T2DM risk. Associated with NAFLD, PCOS, sleep apnoea.
